rush.label: Rush: goes before every other work order on the dispatch board and the tablet

release.pickFirst: Tick the drafts to release first
release.tooMany: Up to {max} work orders at once
release.noDraft: None of the selected is a draft

refusal.stale: Someone changed it since: read it again
refusal.missing: Not found, or no longer in your sites
refusal.forbidden: You may not release this work order
refusal.failed: Something went wrong: nothing was written to this row

release.summary: Each is checked again as it is released: the spec is frozen and a batch number given. A release has no undo.

split.title: Split {number}
split.subtitle: The pieces you choose move into a new draft with its own due date. The order lines stay the same, on two work orders.
split.due: Due date of the new work order
split.dueHint: Starts from this work order's due date.
split.heldFrozen: Only a draft is split: the release freezes its sizes
split.heldKind: A repair or a made-to-measure unit has nothing to split
split.heldOver: A size moves more pieces than it has
split.heldAll: Keep at least one piece on this work order
split.heldApi: This split cannot be made: read the work order again
split.changed: Someone changed this work order: read it again.
split.failed: The split could not be made.

minutes.title: Minutes
minutes.hint: Standard minutes × whole garments reported good, for this work order only
minutes.offStandard: Off-standard minutes are kept per line and day, not per work order: see them on the line's day in Labour & corrections.
minutes.neverPerson: Never per person: a worker's minutes live only in their own record.

docs.title: Documents
docs.travellerHint: PDF with a QR code, the paper that travels with the work. Made on request, stored nowhere.
docs.travellerDraft: PDF with a QR code. While it is a draft it says the sizes are not frozen.

none.title: No work order named
none.body: Open a traveller from a work order or from the list's selection.

traveller.held: The PDF is not ready yet
traveller.storedNowhere: Made on request and stored nowhere.
